CodeGen_Generator.evidence: Backend pass driver; contains both post-schedule and post-coloring trace strings and iterates pcbasicblocks. Canonical name follows the existing MWCC debugger/decomp nomenclature.

colorgraph.evidence: Takes an interference-graph node list, assigns physical colors from an availability mask, and returns failure when a node must spill. Signature and behavior match colorgraph in Coloring.c.

register_allocation_driver.evidence: Iterates seven register classes, constructs a coloring work list, invokes colorgraph, and retries after spill processing.

schedule_current_function.evidence: Called by CodeGen_Generator immediately before the post-schedule trace point.

pcbasicblocks.evidence: CodeGen_Generator walks this linked list and each block's instruction list before object generation.

interferencegraph.evidence: Base pointer used by colorgraph to resolve interference nodes by virtual-register index.

coloring_class.evidence: Register-class selector set by the allocation driver and consumed by colorgraph.

pcode_opcode_table.evidence: PCodeInfo.c initializer 0x0047ccc0 clears 0x4af entries at 0x00626638 with stride 0x30; independent readers at 0x004925c0, 0x0049bd50, and 0x004c2f30 use the same table. Opcode 1 registration at 0x0047ccc0 supplies the sentinel values.
